parameters.jsCode: const i=$('Normalize Email').first().json; const r=$json; const t=(i.subject+'\n'+i.body).toLowerCase(); let intent='GENERAL_SUPPORT'; if(/fraud|unauthori[sz]ed|scam|stolen|suspicious/.test(t))intent='FRAUD'; else if(/dispute|chargeback|charge back/.test(t))intent='DISPUTE'; else if(/transfer|send money|beneficiary/.test(t))intent='TRANSFER'; else if(/standing order|recurring|scheduled payment/.test(t))intent='STANDING_ORDER'; else if(/close account|account closure/.test(t))intent='ACCOUNT_CLOSURE'; else if(/open account|new account/.test(t))intent='ACCOUNT_OPENING'; else if(/statement|transaction history/.test(t))intent='STATEMENT'; else if(/joint|guardian|holder|update account|change details/.test(t))intent='ACCOUNT_UPDATE'; return [{json:{...i,customer:r,customer_exists:!!r?.id,intent,confidence:0.85}}];

const a=$json; return [{json:{...a,decision:'POLICY_CHECK_REQUIRED',requires_human_approval:true,reason:'Account holder changes, joint closure, guardian/minor conversion and authority-model changes require explicit policy evaluation.'}}];

const j=$json; if(!j.source_account_id||!j.destination_account_id||!j.amount||!j.idempotency_key) throw new Error('source_account_id, destination_account_id, amount and idempotency_key are required'); return [{json:j}];

parameters.jsCode: const j=$json; const score=Number(j.risk_score??j.score??0); const level=score>=0.85?'CRITICAL':score>=0.65?'HIGH':score>=0.35?'MEDIUM':'LOW'; return [{json:{...j,risk_score:score,risk_level:level}}];

parameters.jsCode: const q=$('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json; const hits=$json.matches||[]; return [{json:{...q,rag_sources:hits.map(x=>x.id),rag_context:hits.map(x=>x.metadata?.text||x.metadata?.content||'').filter(Boolean).join('\n\n'),requires_approval:true}}];

parameters.jsCode: const accounts=$('Get Accounts').all().map(x=>x.json); const entries=$('Get Ledger Entries').all().map(x=>x.json); const by={}; for(const e of entries){by[e.account_id]=(by[e.account_id]||0)+(e.entry_type==='CREDIT'?Number(e.amount):-Number(e.amount));} return accounts.map(a=>{const ledger=by[a.id]||0; return {json:{account_id:a.id,account_number:a.account_number,reported_balance:Number(a.balance),ledger_balance:ledger,difference:Number(a.balance)-ledger,reconciled:Math.abs(Number(a.balance)-ledger)<0.0001}}});
